# hetznerrobot_boot_linux (Resource)

Activates the automatic Linux installation of a dedicated server. **The installation wipes the server.** It runs on the next reboot — pair it with `hetznerrobot_server_reset` — after which Robot reports `active = false`; the resource keeps that as a fact and never installs again on its own. Only one boot configuration can be active at a time. Destroying the resource deactivates the installation if it is still pending.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Reinstalls server 321 with Debian on its next reboot — this wipes the server.
resource "hetznerrobot_boot_linux" "debian" {
  server_number   = 321
  dist            = "Debian 12 base"
  lang            = "en"
  authorized_keys = [hetznerrobot_ssh_key.admin.fingerprint]
}

resource "hetznerrobot_server_reset" "install" {
  server_number = hetznerrobot_boot_linux.debian.server_number
  type          = "hw"
  triggers = {
    activation = hetznerrobot_boot_linux.debian.password
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dist` (String) Distribution to install (see `hetznerrobot_boot.linux_dists`).
- `lang` (String) Language of the installation, e.g. `en`.
- `server_number` (Number) Server to configure.

### Optional

- `authorized_keys` (Set of String) Fingerprints of SSH keys stored in Robot (`hetznerrobot_ssh_key.fingerprint`) to authorize for root instead of relying on the password. Changing them activates the configuration anew; setting them after an import that could not read them does not.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the configuration is still pending. Robot clears it once the server has booted it.
- `host_keys` (List of String) Host key fingerprints of the booted system, as far as Robot reports them.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Root (or Administrator) password Robot generated on activation. Only the activation answer carries it, so it stays as it was after the configuration is used up.
- `server_ip` (String) Main IP address of the server.
- `server_ipv6_net` (String) Main IPv6 net of the server.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Only a pending (still active) activation can be imported.
tofu import hetznerrobot_boot_linux.debian 321
```
